resources.string: Welcome to Idena Social

The most decentralized social network in the world. This app runs a node of the Idena blockchain: every message is a transaction on it and cannot be erased. What you write on Idena Social stays forever; for more privacy, use the encrypted private chats.
Your account
Connecting to other nodes
Downloading the network
Catching up with the latest blocks
Your phone does not download every block since the start: it downloads the block headers, then the network\'s latest state (a snapshot) from another node.
To use Idena, create or import an account in the node tab. Never lose your private key: no one holds it but you, and no one can recover it for you.
Sync is off: the node does not run, so nothing is read. Turn Sync on at the top of the screen.

Up to date. Your feed fills in as the network is read: the newest posts first.
It can take several minutes, up to about 15, before a first node accepts yours. Keep the app open meanwhile.
On mobile data or a hotspot, other nodes often cannot reach your phone, and it connects slowly. Wi-Fi helps.
Your node waits for another node to send it the network\'s latest state. It goes on by itself once a connection offers it.
It has waited %1$d minutes: your connections do not offer the state yet. It still goes on by itself; more connections help (Wi-Fi, keeping the app open).
The node stops while the phone sleeps or when Android stops the app: it catches up with the blocks made meanwhile when it runs again.
Keep the app open during the first sync: Android may stop the node with the screen off. These settings let it run in the background.

For priority access, add nodes you trust in Direct connections (Advanced settings, in the node tab), and exchange your node codes: your own node running at home all day and night (the Idena desktop app, its router port open), or a validator of the network you trust.
Good to know
The first start takes a while.
A good habit: sync at home on Wi-Fi. Outside, the node then only has the last blocks to catch up with.
Idena is decentralized: you can run a node at home on a computer, all day and night, and link your phone directly to it. Or exchange node codes with friends to connect to the network faster.
You can earn iDNA for free by becoming a validator of the network. The more validators, the faster connections and posts travel, and the lower the fees.
Reading older posts: %1$d%%. They are read only while Idena Social is on screen: keep it open to read them all.
Posting needs a little iDNA

Each post, reply, like or tip is a transaction on the network, with a small fee in iDNA from your account: a part of it goes back to the validators. Your balance is 0 iDNA. Reading Idena Social stays free.
How to get iDNA
Someone sends you some, or tips one of your posts: share your address with them.
Ask in the Idena community chats:
Or earn iDNA for free by becoming a validator of the network.
The more validators, the better for everyone: more nodes to connect to, so faster syncing and posts, and lower fees.
How to become a validator
How to become a validator
Validators hold an Idena identity: one per person, and anonymous: no real name, no ID document. It only proves that a unique human holds it.
1. Get an invitation from a validated member: ask someone you know, or in the community chats.
2. Activate it in the node tab (Activate an invitation code): your account becomes a candidate.
3. Take part in the next validation: at a set date, everyone solves short picture puzzles at the same time, for a few minutes. Passing it validates your identity.
4. A validated identity earns iDNA at each validation, and while its node is online (mining).
